components.name: Search bar
components.description: Search bar — a pill search field for lists and catalogues. Default shows placeholder; Focused lifts to surface/raised, shows the caret, clear button and a Cancel text action; Filled keeps the query with a clear button. M 36 for dense UIs, L 44 for touch. Results update as you type.
